purpose: External partner role: budget/financial questions must be declined, normal questions must still work; researcher control unchanged. Copy to .github/dev-e2e-request.json in a separate commit AFTER the DEV deploy of this change is green.

How many quality-assured Innovation Use results were reported in 2025, and how many of them have a current innovation use level of 7 or higher?
